apps.name: House Help Tracker
apps.tagline: Attendance, salary and UPI pay for your house help, plus expiry reminders.
apps.shareText: House Help Tracker: free app for attendance, salary and UPI pay for your house help, plus expiry reminders.

screenshots.caption: Pay worked out to the paisa
Scan or say the name and date

apps.about: House Help Tracker keeps a simple record for the people who help run your home: your cook, maid, car cleaner, driver, or a stand-in who helps for a few days. Every day counts as present unless you mark it otherwise, and pay is worked out for you.

features.title: Attendance in one tap
points: Absent, half day, planned leave, weekly off or paid holiday
Plan leave ahead for festivals and trips home
A paid holiday for everyone at once

features.title: Pay worked out for you
points: Monthly, weekly or per-day pay
Free leaves, bonus, advances in instalments
Pay by UPI with the amount filled in
Raises never change months already paid

features.title: Slips and reports on WhatsApp
points: Detailed pay slip as a message or picture
Monthly report of everyone's pay and dues
Leave messages in English, Hindi or Marathi

features.title: Expiry tracker for the home
points: Add a photo of each product
Scan or say the name and expiry date
Reminders 7 days before and on the day
Share expiring items on WhatsApp

features.title: Private by design
points: No sign-up, no account, no ads
All records stay on your phone
Optional PIN and fingerprint lock
Backup and restore, light and dark mode

dataSafety.title: Your records stay on your phone
dataSafety.text: Names, numbers, pay, attendance and items are never sent to the developer or anyone else.

dataSafety.title: No ads, no tracking
dataSafety.text: The app has no ads and no analytics of its own.

dataSafety.title: Google diagnostics for scanning
dataSafety.text: Google ML Kit, used to read packs on the phone, may send Google basic diagnostics such as phone model and app performance. Photos are never sent.

notes: Extra work: note when your house help does more than usual, such as cooking for guests, a party or function, extra cleaning or extra hours. Pick the dates (for example 8 to 19 November), how many extra people, and how you pay: per extra person per day, per day, a fixed amount, or no extra pay (just a note).
The extra pay is worked out for you (for example 3 people × 12 days × ₹50 = ₹1,800) and added to that month's pay.
It shows on the person's page, as a green + on those days in the calendar, on the pay slip (message and picture) and in the monthly report.
Optionally send a thank-you message saying the amount is added to their pay, in English, Hindi or Marathi.

Common reasons in one tap: when you mark Absent, Half day or any leave, pick a reason instead of typing it: unwell, fever, child unwell, going to the village, wedding or function, festival, guests at home, doctor visit, heavy rain, no bus or auto, came late, left early and more. Reasons show in English, Hindi or Marathi.

When you ask them not to come: a second set of reasons for your side: we are going out, out of town, eating out tonight (don't come in the evening), lunch outside or not needed in the morning, not needed today, festival holiday and more. These are saved as paid leave or a paid half day, so no money is cut.

The right message: for your reasons, the WhatsApp/SMS message tells them not to come on that day (or that morning or evening) and that no money will be cut, in their language. For their reasons, the message includes the reason.
Tapping Absent or Half day on the Today card now opens these reasons first. Plan leave has the same reasons too.
Easier to tap: the month arrows, Pay, Give advance, Copy, category chips and other small buttons now have a bigger touch area.
Hindi and Marathi: "Weekly off" no longer shows the same word as Leave or Holiday in the calendar key and totals.
Small phones: the three totals on Home and Expiry stay in one neat row, the month name no longer wraps, and long names on the Payments page stay within two lines.
Safer records: a damaged advance entry from an old backup can no longer stop a person's page from opening.
Saved confirmation: when you mark absent, half day, any kind of leave, a weekly off or a holiday, a "Saved" pop-up with a tick shows what was saved, for whom, the date and the reason.
Back button on it: tap Back to return to Home, or Done to stay on the person's page.
Send message is now a button on the same pop-up, so the leave message opens only when you want it.
Paid leave: give your cook, maid or any house help a full day or half day of paid leave. Tap a day → More → Paid leave or Paid half day, and add the reason. No money is cut for it.
The reason shows in the month's leave log, and paid leave days are listed on the pay slip.

Free trial is now 45 days: every feature is free for 45 days from when you first used version 1.21 or later. After that, one house help with attendance and pay stays free, and Pro (₹49 a month or ₹399 a year) unlocks everything.
Send feedback and Share the app in Settings now open the app's page on appbucket.in.
Free trial: every feature is free for 45 days.
After that, free plan: one house help with attendance and pay keeps working. Your other records stay safe, and backup and restore always work.
Pro (₹49 a month or ₹399 a year): all your house help, the expiry tracker and reminders, the monthly report, WhatsApp pay slips and paying with a UPI app.
Getting Pro: Settings → Get Pro. Pay by UPI, send the details on WhatsApp, then enter the unlock code you get back.
Send feedback and share the app from Settings.
Add a photo of each product when you add an expiry item.
A simpler Expiry page: just Add at the top; scanning is inside Add item.
New name: House Help Tracker. Your records are unchanged.
Monthly, weekly or per-day pay.
Temporary help with an exit date.
Monthly report for all house help, ready to send on WhatsApp.

apps.name: AdShield
apps.tagline: Block ads and trackers in every app and browser. 14 days free, then ₹29 a month. Free iPhone profile.
permissions: VPN (local, to filter ad and tracker lookups)
apps.shareText: AdShield: free ad and tracker blocker for Android. Works in every app and browser, no server or sign-up.
apps.about:
AdShield blocks ads, trackers and analytics across your whole phone, in apps and browsers, on Wi-Fi and mobile data. It uses Android's VPN feature locally, so there's no VPN server and your browsing isn't sent anywhere. Tap the shield once and it keeps working in the background.

Try everything free for 14 days. After that, AdShield Pro keeps the shield on: ₹29 a month or ₹249 a year, paid by UPI. Pay in your UPI app, send the details on WhatsApp, and you get an unlock code for your phone. The iPhone profile stays free.

dataSafety.title: Filtering happens on your phone

dataSafety.text: The app has no ads and no analytics.

dataSafety.title: Normal DNS for allowed sites
dataSafety.text: Names that aren't blocked are looked up with Cloudflare (1.1.1.1) or Google (8.8.8.8) public DNS, as your phone normally would.

notes: AdShield Pro: everything is free for 14 days from when you update. After that, Pro keeps the shield on for ₹29 a month or ₹249 a year.
Getting Pro: tap the Pro line under the shield, pick a plan, pay by UPI, send the details on WhatsApp, then paste the unlock code you get back.
If the trial or Pro ends while the shield is on, AdShield stops and tells you in a notification.
iPhone: free AdShield setup profile. On the app page on your iPhone, tap Set up on iPhone. Needs iOS 14 or later.
First release: block ads and trackers in every app, live blocked list, allowlist and blocklist updates.
Tip: for full blocking, set Private DNS to Off or Automatic, and turn off Use secure DNS in Chrome.

ios.note: On iPhone, AdShield is a free settings profile instead of an app. It switches your iPhone to AdGuard's ad-blocking DNS over an encrypted connection, so ads and trackers are blocked in every app and browser, on Wi-Fi and mobile data. There's no app screen or blocked list on iPhone. Needs iOS 14 or later.

apps.name: SpendSense
apps.tagline: Turn your bank, UPI and card SMS into an expense tracker. No internet, nothing leaves your phone.
apps.shareText: SpendSense: free expense tracker that turns your bank and UPI SMS into a monthly spending report. No internet, no sign-up.
apps.about: SpendSense turns the transaction SMS your bank, UPI app and credit card send you into an expense tracker. Share a bank SMS to SpendSense from your Messages app, or paste a few at once, and it picks out the amount, who you paid, the date, the account and how you paid. Spends are sorted into categories like Food, Groceries, Shopping, Travel and Bills, so you can see each month where your money went. SpendSense doesn't need SMS permission or internet access, so your messages and expenses stay on your phone.

points: Spent this month, with change vs last month
Monthly budget with how much is left
Category ring and recent transactions at a glance

notes: Fixed: Google Play Protect could stop the install. The app now asks for no permissions at all.
All-new design: Home dashboard, Transactions, Insights and Settings tabs.
Monthly budget, change vs last month, 6-month trend, top merchants.
Search and filter transactions, grouped by day. New editor with categories and a date picker.
If you installed version 1.x, uninstall it once before installing 2.0. Future updates will install normally.
Fixed: Android no longer blocks installing SpendSense. The app no longer asks for SMS permission.
Add transactions by sharing a bank SMS from Messages (long-press → Share → SpendSense), or paste several SMS at once.
The transaction date is now read from the SMS itself.
First release: automatic expense tracking from bank, UPI and card SMS, categories, monthly summary, manual entries and CSV export.
